unit.why: A memorate in which the rebbe of Mogielnica tells how, during wartime, the heavenly prince of the enemy came to summon him to judgment and the deceased R. Mendel of Romanów came to his aid.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפיו הק' ז"ל שאמר כי
stories.end_quote: ד"ת זו משמו כנודע לכל אנ"ש
stories.summary_en: During a wartime emergency the rebbe prayed constantly for the Russian Tsar's victory. On the second night of Rosh Hashanah the heavenly prince of the enemy appeared and summoned him to judgment above. The deceased R. Mendel of Romanów appeared, told him not to fear and said he would cast the prince down; from this the rebbe knew Russia would win. He explained that R. Mendel came because that night he had said a Torah teaching in R. Mendel's name, and he repeated it every year afterwards.
